company.name: Infinitus Systems
company.shortDescription: AI healthcare company focused on automating complex phone-based workflows
company.description: Infinitus Systems is an AI healthcare company that automates phone calls. By automating tedious and time-consuming phone-based processes across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re improving therapy access, adherence, and affordability for patients. Healthcare is one of the biggest contributors to the US GDP and we are on a mission to reduce the complexity and spend on back-office administration. Infinitus has raised $51.4M to date and is backed by leading growth investors Kleiner Perkins, Coatue, and Google Ventures. Learn more by visiting infinitus.ai or contact us to get started.
